corrections.reason: The word printed is በገባዕ ('at the gathering/feast'), with 6th-order ዕ (note the top bend of ዕ), not 1st-order ዐ.
Classical Ge'ez gerundive of ሖረ is ሐዊሮሙ (with 1st-order ሐ), not ሖዊሮሙ; the image clearly shows ሐ without a 7th-order loop.
Amharic converb translating Ge'ez አእኰተ is አመስግኖ ('having given thanks', parallel to አንስቶ and ቆርሶ); the 7th-order ring on ኖ is visible in the image.
The split word across L21-L22 is እንግዲህ (with 3rd-order ዲ having a horizontal foot, not a 5th-order loop ዴ).
The proclitic conjunction ወ- at the end of L26 wraps directly into ተካፈልዎ on L27 (ወተካፈልዎ).
